description: Placed into long-term storage at RAAF Pearce and approved for disposal 23/01/1970. Mounted on a metal framework on a concrete pad outside the former aeronautical museum on Vincent Street and in the open air since 1970; the Shire's 2010s significance assessment rates its condition as fair with interior components removed (ADF-Serials).
aliases: Vampire; DH115; Vampire T.35; Vampire T35; c/n 4160

description: Received September 1959, flew with No. 34 (Special Transport) Squadron then 1 AFTS and 2 FTS at Pearce; approved for disposal February 1970. Acquired by the Rotary Club of Geraldton, abandoned at Geraldton airport in 1971 and later preserved by the Geraldton Chamber of Commerce. Displayed on Hunt Road, Beverley, adjacent to the museum grounds (ADF-Serials).
aliases: Vampire; DH115; Vampire T.35; Vampire T35; c/n 4173
